# Quick-reference executable sources

The four complete programs were extracted byte-for-byte from the retired
0.2.7 quick reference during the 0.2.8 docs reduction. They remain executable
regressions in [qli_corpus.rs](../../qli_corpus.rs), with independent expected
distributions for phase cancellation, teleportation, phase kickback and static
operation substitution. They inherit edition 2026 from the test manifest.

The explanatory reference remains in the [fixed release source](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/blob/v0.2.7/docs/qli-quick-reference.md).
